event_id_scheme: sha256(UTF8(HEARTHLINE-MILLENNIUM-EVENT-V1\0) || RFC8785_JCS(payload_without_event_id)); no floating-point values and ASCII object-member names

target.statement: Determine the exact minimum NAND-gate count of every Boolean function on two inputs in the declared circuit model.
target.scope: Finite two-input, two-input-NAND-only circuits; unbounded fan-out; no free constants or negated inputs.
target.quantifiers: For each of the 16 Boolean functions, over every finite acyclic circuit in the declared model.

board.objects: Topologically ordered NAND-gate sequences with each gate's operand pair canonicalized, plus four-bit truth-table masks.
board.legal_moves: Append one NAND gate whose unordered operand pair, with repetition, is drawn from the primary inputs and earlier gates.
board.adversary: Every smaller circuit sequence and every one of the four input assignments.
board.verifier: Deterministic exhaustive enumeration plus exact four-bit truth-table evaluation.

environment.algorithm: deterministic exhaustive enumeration using Python standard library

claim_delta.basis: Complete enumeration of all circuit sequences of sizes zero through five and an exact witness for every two-input Boolean function.

limitations: session declaration is not provider attestation
hidden routing and training ancestry are not excluded

known_omissions: provider-signed request and runtime identity receipts
